def ordered(tasks):
    return sorted(tasks, key=lambda t: t.id)


def render(tasks):
    return "\n".join("%d [%s] %s" % (t.id, "x" if t.done else " ", t.text) for t in ordered(tasks))
=======
def ordered(tasks):
    priority_order = {"high": 0, "normal": 1, "low": 2}
    return sorted(tasks, key=lambda t: (priority_order[t.priority], t.id))


def render(tasks):
    return "\n".join("%d [%s] %s" % (t.id, "x" if t.done else " ", t.text) for t in ordered(tasks))

def load(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return []
    with open(path) as f:
        return [Task(id=r["id"], text=r["text"], done=r.get("done", False)) for r in json.load(f)]
=======
def load(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return []
    with open(path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
        tasks = [Task(id=r["id"], text=r["text"], done=r.get("done", False), priority=r.get("priority", "normal")) for r in data]
        return tasks
